question_en: Which statements are true? 1) the current in metals is the ordered motion of free electrons; 2) the Tolman–Stewart experiment showed that the charge carriers in metals are negative; 3) when a metal is heated, its resistance decreases; 4) when a current passes through metals, substance is transferred.
question_uz: Qaysi fikrlar to'g'ri? 1) metallarda tok erkin elektronlarning tartibli harakatidan iborat; 2) Tolmen–Styuart tajribasi metallarda zaryad tashuvchilar manfiy ekanini ko'rsatdi; 3) metall qizdirilganda uning qarshiligi kamayadi; 4) metallardan tok o'tganda modda ko'chadi.
question_ru: Какие утверждения верны? 1) ток в металлах — упорядоченное движение свободных электронов; 2) опыт Толмена–Стюарта показал, что носители заряда в металлах отрицательны; 3) при нагревании металла его сопротивление уменьшается; 4) при прохождении тока через металлы переносится вещество.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. Metallarda tokni erkin elektronlar tashiydi (Tolmen–Styuart), modda ko'chmaydi; qizdirilganda R ortadi (α > 0).
Asos: metallarning elektron o'tkazuvchanligi.

distractors_ru.A: считали, что при нагревании сопротивление уменьшается
distractors_ru.C: считали, что в металлах переносится вещество

distractors_en.A: the resistance was assumed to decrease on heating
distractors_en.C: substance transfer was assumed in metals
distractors_en.D: statement 3 was also taken as true

question_en: The resistance of a wire at $0\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ is $8\ \Omega$, and the temperature coefficient of resistance is $4.5\cdot10^{-3}\ \mathrm{K^{-1}}$. Find the resistance of the wire at $120\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ ($\Omega$).
question_uz: Simning $0\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ dagi qarshiligi $8\ \Omega$, qarshilikning temperatura koeffitsiyenti $4.5\cdot10^{-3}\ \mathrm{K^{-1}}$. Simning $120\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ dagi qarshiligini toping ($\Omega$).
question_ru: Сопротивление провода при $0\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ равно $8\ \Omega$, температурный коэффициент сопротивления $4.5\cdot10^{-3}\ \mathrm{K^{-1}}$. Найдите сопротивление провода при $120\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ ($\Omega$).

distractors_ru.E: вместо t подставлена температура в кельвинах

distractors_en.A: only the increase R₀αt was found
distractors_en.B: division was done instead of multiplication

question_en: To what temperature ($^\circ\mathrm{C}$) must a tungsten wire be heated for its resistance to become $3$ times greater than at $0\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$? $\alpha=5\cdot10^{-3}\ \mathrm{K^{-1}}$.
question_uz: Volfram simning qarshiligi $0\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ dagidan $3$ marta katta bo'lishi uchun uni qanday temperaturagacha ($^\circ\mathrm{C}$) qizdirish kerak? $\alpha=5\cdot10^{-3}\ \mathrm{K^{-1}}$.
question_ru: До какой температуры ($^\circ\mathrm{C}$) нужно нагреть вольфрамовую проволоку, чтобы её сопротивление стало в $3$ раза больше, чем при $0\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$? $\alpha=5\cdot10^{-3}\ \mathrm{K^{-1}}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. 3R₀ = R₀(1 + αt) ⇒ αt = 2 ⇒ t = 2/α = 2/(5·10⁻³) = 400 °C.
Asos: R = R₀(1 + αt).

distractors_en.C: the condition for a 2-fold increase was solved
distractors_en.E: the answer was converted to kelvins

question_en: Which of the following elements must be added to silicon (valence $\mathrm{IV}$) to obtain an n-type semiconductor? The valences of the elements are given in brackets.
question_uz: Kremniyga ($\mathrm{IV}$ valentli) quyidagi elementlardan qaysi biri qo'shilsa, n-turdagi yarimo'tkazgich hosil bo'ladi? Qavslar ichida elementlarning valentligi berilgan.
question_ru: Какой из следующих элементов нужно ввести в кремний ($\mathrm{IV}$-валентный), чтобы получить полупроводник n-типа? В скобках указана валентность элементов.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. Besh valentli mishyakning beshinchi elektroni erkin bo'ladi — donor, asosiy tashuvchilar elektronlar (n-tur).
Asos: donor aralashma — n-tur.

uz: Valentlik asosiy moddanikidan katta — donor: $$\mathrm{V}>\mathrm{IV}\ \Rightarrow\ n_e\gg n_p$$
ru: Валентность больше, чем у основного вещества, — донор: $$\mathrm{V}>\mathrm{IV}\ \Rightarrow\ n_e\gg n_p$$
en: The valence is greater than the host's — a donor: $$\mathrm{V}>\mathrm{IV}\ \Rightarrow\ n_e\gg n_p$$

distractors.A: uch valentli bor — akseptor, p-tur beradi
distractors.B: uch valentli galliy — akseptor, p-tur beradi
distractors.C: uch valentli indiy — akseptor, p-tur beradi

distractors_en.A: trivalent boron is an acceptor and gives p-type
distractors_en.B: trivalent gallium is an acceptor and gives p-type
distractors_en.C: trivalent indium is an acceptor and gives p-type
distractors_en.E: tetravalent germanium does not change the type

question_en: The figure shows graphs of resistivity versus temperature for four conductors. Which graph belongs to a superconductor and which to a semiconductor (in this order)?
question_uz: Rasmda to'rt xil o'tkazgich solishtirma qarshiligining temperaturaga bog'liqlik grafiklari berilgan. Qaysi grafik o'ta o'tkazgichga va qaysi biri yarimo'tkazgichga tegishli (shu tartibda)?
question_ru: На рисунке даны графики зависимости удельного сопротивления четырёх проводников от температуры. Какой график относится к сверхпроводнику и какой — к полупроводнику (в этом порядке)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. 3-grafik T* da sakrab nolga tushadi — o'ta o'tkazgich; 2-grafik T ortganda keskin kamayadi — yarimo'tkazgich.
Asos: ρ(T) shakli.

uz: 3 — sakrab nolga tushadi, 2 — keskin kamayadi: $$T<T^*:\ \rho=0;\qquad T\uparrow\ \Rightarrow\ \rho\downarrow$$
ru: 3 — скачком падает до нуля, 2 — резко убывает: $$T<T^*:\ \rho=0;\qquad T\uparrow\ \Rightarrow\ \rho\downarrow$$
en: 3 drops abruptly to zero, 2 falls sharply: $$T<T^*:\ \rho=0;\qquad T\uparrow\ \Rightarrow\ \rho\downarrow$$

rules.ru: Полупроводник: с ростом $T$ сопротивление $R$ резко падает

distractors.D: o'zgarmas qarshilik o'ta o'tkazgich deb olingan

distractors_en.A: graph 1 (a metal, rising linearly) was chosen
distractors_en.B: graph 4 (almost constant, an alloy) was chosen
distractors_en.D: a constant resistance was taken as a superconductor

question_en: The saturation current of a vacuum diode is $6.4\ \mathrm{mA}$. How many electrons leave the cathode in $2.5\ \mathrm{s}$?
question_uz: Vakuumli diodning to'yinish toki $6.4\ \mathrm{mA}$. Katoddan $2.5\ \mathrm{s}$ davomida nechta elektron uchib chiqadi?
question_ru: Ток насыщения вакуумного диода $6.4\ \mathrm{mA}$. Сколько электронов вылетает из катода за $2.5\ \mathrm{s}$?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. To'yinishda chiqqan barcha elektronlar anodga yetadi: N = It/e = 6,4·10⁻³·2,5/(1,6·10⁻¹⁹) = 10¹⁷.
Asos: q = It = Ne.

en: Saturation current and the number of electrons: $$N=\frac{It}{e}=\frac{6.4\cdot10^{-3}\cdot2.5}{1.6\cdot10^{-19}}=10^{17}$$

distractors_ru.C: вместо умножения на время выполнено деление
distractors_ru.E: вместо деления на e выполнено умножение

distractors_en.A: the number per 1 second was found (t omitted)
distractors_en.C: it was divided by the time instead of multiplied
distractors_en.D: milliamperes were not converted to amperes
distractors_en.E: it was multiplied by e instead of divided

question_en: In a diode an electron leaves the cathode with no initial speed and reaches the anode with a speed of $4\cdot10^6\ \mathrm{m/s}$. Find the anode voltage ($\mathrm{V}$). $m=9.1\cdot10^{-31}\ \mathrm{kg}$, $e=1.6\cdot10^{-19}\ \mathrm{C}$.
question_uz: Diodda elektron katoddan boshlang'ich tezliksiz chiqib, anodga $4\cdot10^6\ \mathrm{m/s}$ tezlik bilan yetib keldi. Anod kuchlanishini toping ($\mathrm{V}$). $m=9.1\cdot10^{-31}\ \mathrm{kg}$, $e=1.6\cdot10^{-19}\ \mathrm{C}$.
question_ru: В диоде электрон вылетает из катода без начальной скорости и достигает анода со скоростью $4\cdot10^6\ \mathrm{m/s}$. Найдите анодное напряжение ($\mathrm{V}$). $m=9.1\cdot10^{-31}\ \mathrm{kg}$, $e=1.6\cdot10^{-19}\ \mathrm{C}$.

en: The work of the field equals the kinetic energy: $$U=\frac{mv^2}{2e}=\frac{9.1\cdot10^{-31}\cdot1.6\cdot10^{13}}{3.2\cdot10^{-19}}=45.5\ \mathrm{V}$$

distractors_en.A: the factor 1/2 in the kinetic energy was forgotten
distractors_en.B: 4e was used in the denominator instead of 2e
distractors_en.E: it was multiplied by 2 instead of 1/2

question_en: The current in a vacuum diode has not reached saturation. When the anode voltage is increased $9$ times, the current still does not saturate. How many times will the current increase?
question_uz: Vakuumli dioddagi tok to'yinishga yetmagan. Anod kuchlanishi $9$ marta oshirilganda ham tok to'yinmaydi. Tok kuchi necha marta ortadi?
question_ru: Ток в вакуумном диоде не достиг насыщения. При увеличении анодного напряжения в $9$ раз ток тоже не насыщается. Во сколько раз возрастёт сила тока?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. Boguslavskiy–Lengmyur qonuni I = aU√U: tok 9·√9 = 27 marta ortadi.
Asos: I ∼ U√U (to'yinishgacha).

distractors.C: tok kuchlanish ildiziga proporsional deb olingan
distractors.D: tok kuchlanish kvadratiga proporsional deb olingan

distractors_ru.C: ток принят пропорциональным корню из напряжения

distractors_en.C: the current was taken as proportional to the square root of the voltage
distractors_en.D: the current was taken as proportional to the square of the voltage
distractors_en.E: the power ratio was found (P ∼ U²√U)

question_en: Which statements are true? 1) in electrolytes the current is carried by positive and negative ions; 2) as the temperature rises, the resistance of an electrolyte decreases; 3) in electrolysis cations move towards the anode; 4) the unit of the electrochemical equivalent is $\mathrm{kg/C}$.
question_uz: Qaysi fikrlar to'g'ri? 1) elektrolitlarda tokni musbat va manfiy ionlar tashiydi; 2) temperatura ortganda elektrolit qarshiligi kamayadi; 3) elektrolizda kationlar anod tomon harakatlanadi; 4) elektrokimyoviy ekvivalentning birligi $\mathrm{kg/C}$.
question_ru: Какие утверждения верны? 1) в электролитах ток переносят положительные и отрицательные ионы; 2) с ростом температуры сопротивление электролита уменьшается; 3) при электролизе катионы движутся к аноду; 4) единица электрохимического эквивалента — $\mathrm{kg/C}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. Elektrolitda ion o'tkazuvchanlik, qizdirilganda R kamayadi; kationlar (+) katodga boradi; k = m/q, kg/C.
Asos: m = kq.

ru: 1, 2 верны; 3 неверно — катион идёт к катоду: $$\alpha<0,\qquad +\ \to\ -$$
en: 1, 2 are true; 3 is false — a cation goes to the cathode: $$\alpha<0,\qquad +\ \to\ -$$

distractors_ru.B: считали, что катионы идут к аноду

distractors_en.A: statement 4 (the unit) was taken as false
distractors_en.B: cations were assumed to go to the anode
distractors_en.C: statement 3 was taken as true and 1 as false
distractors_en.E: all statements were taken as true

question_en: A current of $4\ \mathrm{A}$ passed through a nickel salt solution for $45$ minutes. How many grams of nickel were liberated at the cathode? $k=0.3\cdot10^{-6}\ \mathrm{kg/C}$.
question_uz: Nikel tuzi eritmasidan $45$ minut davomida $4\ \mathrm{A}$ tok o'tdi. Katodda necha gramm nikel ajraldi? $k=0.3\cdot10^{-6}\ \mathrm{kg/C}$.
question_ru: Через раствор соли никеля в течение $45$ минут шёл ток $4\ \mathrm{A}$. Сколько граммов никеля выделилось на катоде? $k=0.3\cdot10^{-6}\ \mathrm{kg/C}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. t = 45·60 = 2700 s, m = kIt = 0,3·10⁻⁶·4·2700 = 3,24·10⁻³ kg = 3,24 g.
Asos: Faradeyning birinchi qonuni m = kIt.

distractors_ru.D: сила тока не подставлена в формулу

distractors_en.A: the time was left in minutes
distractors_en.B: the result was additionally divided by the valence (2)
distractors_en.C: the result was additionally multiplied by the valence (2)

question_en: How many grams of aluminium are liberated when a charge of $9650\ \mathrm{C}$ passes through a molten aluminium salt? $M=27\ \mathrm{g/mol}$, $n=3$, $F=96\,500\ \mathrm{C/mol}$.
question_uz: Alyuminiy tuzi suyuqlanmasidan $9650\ \mathrm{C}$ zaryad o'tganda necha gramm alyuminiy ajraladi? $M=27\ \mathrm{g/mol}$, $n=3$, $F=96\,500\ \mathrm{C/mol}$.
question_ru: Сколько граммов алюминия выделится при прохождении через расплав соли алюминия заряда $9650\ \mathrm{C}$? $M=27\ \mathrm{g/mol}$, $n=3$, $F=96\,500\ \mathrm{C/mol}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. q = 0,1F; m = (1/F)(M/n)q = 0,1·27/3 = 0,9 g — har bir ion 3e zaryad olib keladi.
Asos: m = (1/F)(M/n)q.

distractors.D: molyar massa kg/mol da deb olingan

distractors_ru.C: вместо деления на валентность выполнено умножение

question_en: Two baths with solutions of copper ($\mathrm{Cu^{2+}}$) and silver ($\mathrm{Ag^+}$) salts are connected in series. In the silver bath $5.4\ \mathrm{g}$ of silver was liberated. How many grams of copper were liberated in the copper bath? $M_{Cu}=64\ \mathrm{g/mol}$, $M_{Ag}=108\ \mathrm{g/mol}$.
question_uz: Mis ($\mathrm{Cu^{2+}}$) va kumush ($\mathrm{Ag^+}$) tuzlari eritmalari solingan ikki vanna ketma-ket ulangan. Kumushli vannada $5.4\ \mathrm{g}$ kumush ajraldi. Misli vannada necha gramm mis ajralgan? $M_{Cu}=64\ \mathrm{g/mol}$, $M_{Ag}=108\ \mathrm{g/mol}$.
question_ru: Две ванны с растворами солей меди ($\mathrm{Cu^{2+}}$) и серебра ($\mathrm{Ag^+}$) соединены последовательно. В серебряной ванне выделилось $5.4\ \mathrm{g}$ серебра. Сколько граммов меди выделилось в медной ванне? $M_{Cu}=64\ \mathrm{g/mol}$, $M_{Ag}=108\ \mathrm{g/mol}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. Zaryad bir xil: massalar kimyoviy ekvivalentlarga proporsional, m = 5,4·(64/2)/108 = 1,6 g.
Asos: q₁ = q₂, m ∼ M/n.

ru: Массы относятся как химические эквиваленты: $$\frac{m_{Cu}}{m_{Ag}}=\frac{64/2}{108/1}\ \Rightarrow\ m_{Cu}=5.4\cdot\frac{32}{108}=1.6\ \mathrm{g}$$
en: Masses are as the chemical equivalents: $$\frac{m_{Cu}}{m_{Ag}}=\frac{64/2}{108/1}\ \Rightarrow\ m_{Cu}=5.4\cdot\frac{32}{108}=1.6\ \mathrm{g}$$

distractors.B: nisbat teskari olingan va valentlikka ko'paytirilgan

distractors_ru.B: отношение перевёрнуто и умножено на валентность

distractors_en.B: the ratio was inverted and multiplied by the valence
distractors_en.D: the ratio of molar masses was inverted
distractors_en.E: the mass was simply divided by the valence

question_en: Which statements are true? 1) a discharge that stops when the ionizer is removed is non-self-sustained; 2) at saturation all ions created by the ionizer reach the electrodes; 3) in a self-sustained discharge new carriers arise by impact ionization; 4) under normal conditions a gas is a good conductor.
question_uz: Qaysi fikrlar to'g'ri? 1) ionizator olinganda to'xtaydigan razryad — nomustaqil razryad; 2) to'yinishda ionizator hosil qilgan barcha ionlar elektrodlarga yetadi; 3) mustaqil razryadda yangi tashuvchilar zarbli ionlanishdan hosil bo'ladi; 4) normal sharoitda gaz — yaxshi o'tkazgich.
question_ru: Какие утверждения верны? 1) разряд, прекращающийся после удаления ионизатора, — несамостоятельный; 2) при насыщении все ионы, созданные ионизатором, достигают электродов; 3) в самостоятельном разряде новые носители возникают при ударной ионизации; 4) при нормальных условиях газ — хороший проводник.

Asos: gaz razryadi.

question_en: The ionization energy of an argon atom is $15.8\ \mathrm{eV}$, and the mean free path of an electron is $2\ \mu\mathrm{m}$. Find the minimum field strength at which impact ionization begins ($\mathrm{MV/m}$).
question_uz: Argon atomining ionlanish energiyasi $15.8\ \mathrm{eV}$, elektronning erkin yugurish yo'li $2\ \mu\mathrm{m}$. Zarbli ionlanish boshlanadigan eng kichik maydon kuchlanganligini toping ($\mathrm{MV/m}$).
question_ru: Энергия ионизации атома аргона $15.8\ \mathrm{eV}$, длина свободного пробега электрона $2\ \mu\mathrm{m}$. Найдите наименьшую напряжённость поля, при которой начинается ударная ионизация ($\mathrm{MV/m}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. eEλ = Wᵢ ⇒ E = Wᵢ/(eλ) = 15,8 V/(2·10⁻⁶ m) = 7,9·10⁶ V/m = 7,9 MV/m.
Asos: zarbli ionlanish sharti eEλ ≥ Wᵢ.

uz: Erkin yugurish yo'lida olingan energiya: $$eE\lambda=W_i\ \Rightarrow\ E=\frac{15.8\ \mathrm{V}}{2\cdot10^{-6}\ \mathrm{m}}=7.9\cdot10^6\ \mathrm{V/m}$$
ru: Энергия, набранная на длине свободного пробега: $$eE\lambda=W_i\ \Rightarrow\ E=\frac{15.8\ \mathrm{V}}{2\cdot10^{-6}\ \mathrm{m}}=7.9\cdot10^6\ \mathrm{V/m}$$
en: Energy gained over the mean free path: $$eE\lambda=W_i\ \Rightarrow\ E=\frac{15.8\ \mathrm{V}}{2\cdot10^{-6}\ \mathrm{m}}=7.9\cdot10^6\ \mathrm{V/m}$$

distractors_ru.C: не выполнено деление на длину пробега

distractors_en.A: the result was divided by two
distractors_en.B: the result was multiplied by two
distractors_en.C: it was not divided by the mean free path
distractors_en.D: millimetres were used instead of micrometres
